evidence: The XRR analysis also provided the density of the growing SnO2 films from measurement of the critical angle in the XRR spectra. The crystalline structure of the films was examined by glancing angle X-ray diffraction (GAXRD) at an incident angle of 2°. The surface morphology of the films was examined by atomic force microscopy (AFM). The impurity contents of the SnO2 films were observed by auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and secondary ions mass spectroscopy (SIMS). X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was employed to study the chemical binding states of the SnO2 films. The resistivity of the SnO2 films was measured by a four-point probe method. The step coverage of the film was observed by cross-section SEM.
